mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names a specific point in the diagram (the common endpoint of the two rays at the marked angle). Right image: O names a specific point in the diagram (the common intersection of the horizontal and sloping lines).
Rationales: In both images, O names a specific point in the diagram. The relevant locations are the common endpoint of the two rays at the marked angle on the left and the common intersection of the horizontal and sloping lines on the right.
